user.title: Xiaomi account
user.description: Sign in with your Mi Home account. The map is downloaded from the Xiaomi cloud.

data.username: Username (e-mail, phone number or user ID)

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
Xiaomi requires a captcha. Type the characters shown in the image.

![Captcha](data:image/png;base64,{captcha_image})

two_factor.title: Two-step verification
two_factor.description: Xiaomi sent a verification code to your e-mail address. If you did not receive it, open {url} in a browser, complete the verification and try again.

device.title: Select the robot
device.description: Choose the robot vacuum. Commands are sent locally when the IP address and token are known, the map itself is always downloaded from the cloud.

data.host: Local IP address (optional, taken from the cloud if empty)

abort.no_devices: No supported robot vacuum was found on this account

init.title: Map options
init.description: Room colors are assigned in room number order. Leave empty to use the theme colors.

read_rooms.name: Read rooms
read_rooms.description: Reads the rooms (room-information), the current map and the map backup list from the robot. Read-only.

config_entry_id.name: Robot
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several robots are configured.

merge_rooms.name: Merge rooms (experimental)
merge_rooms.description: Asks the robot to merge adjacent rooms. Format not documented by Xiaomi: back up the map first.

config_entry_id.name: Robot
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several robots are configured.

params.name: Raw parameter
params.description: Text sent as-is to the robot. For merging, replaces the default {"room":[...]} format.

confirm.name: I backed up the map
confirm.description: Must be enabled: the command changes the map stored in the robot.

split_room.name: Split a room (experimental)
split_room.description: Sends the split-room command with the raw parameter given. Format not documented by Xiaomi: back up the map first.
